checks: National LIDAR Programme provides 1m elevation data for England
Phase 1 capture ran across winter survey seasons from 2017 to February 2023
repeat capture is requirement-driven rather than a guaranteed full rolling refresh
survey products are published on an ongoing quarterly basis
products use 5km tiles aligned to the OS grid
point cloud is supplied as LAZ discrete returns
automated classes include ground and low medium high vegetation
DTM uses last-return pulses classified as ground and filters surface objects
time-stamped point cloud separates ground and surface-object classes
manual editing of final DTM means classified ground points do not necessarily equal the final DTM
historic archiving means a surface model may not always have a matching point-cloud archive
promotion_rule: Prefer final DTM for terrain; use point cloud as lineage/QC evidence unless equivalence is proven.
